# Stay Tilted

> Stay Tilted is a cosplay, portrait, event and brand photographer with a themed photography studio in Springs, Gauteng, South Africa. Sessions are fully guided, so clients don't need to know how to pose. The business is LGBT+ owned and neurodivergent-positive.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.staytilted.co.za/): services, studio hire, packages and prices (ZAR), about, FAQ and enquiry form
- [Gallery](https://www.staytilted.co.za/gallery.html): full photo gallery, filterable by category (cosplay, anime and manga, portraits, music events)

## Services and prices (South African rand)

- In-studio photography, guided session on the current themed set: Mini R700 (5 edited photos, 1.5 hr, 1 person); Full R1500 (10 edited photos, 1-3 hr, 1-3 people)
- On-location photography: Mini R700 (8 edited photos, 1 hr, 1 person); Extended R1300 (15 edited photos, 1-3 hr, 1-3 people). Travel is free within 15km of Springs, then R5 per km
- Event photography (e.g. burlesque performances, parties): R150 per hour worked, R500 per 100 photos
- Studio and set rental for your own shoot with your own photographer: R500 per hour, extended time R250 per 30 minutes

## Policies

- Bookings are by appointment. A deposit confirms the booking; it is non-refundable with less than 5 days' notice but can be transferred to a new date once
- Everyone on set signs an indemnity waiver
- Edited photos include one free revision
- Paid-for photos may be used commercially by the models and photographers without mandatory credit
